title: Builder Control — Task Packet
description: The unit of authorization. No agent may write a protected path, push to a public repo, or run a forbidden-by-default op without a conforming packet. The packet's authorization{} is the ONLY override mechanism in the whole system, and creating one leaves a ledger trail. There is no silent bypass.

agentId.description: MUST match a key in agent-registry.json.

objective.description: One precise sentence: what done looks like.

constraints.description: Hard rules this work must respect (reuse>rebuild, anti-theater, no parallel canon, etc.).

sourceOfTruth.description: Authoritative files this work reads/implements against. Builder packets point at builder-control/CONTROL-CONTRACT.md.

filesAllowed.description: Exact paths and * or ** globs this packet may edit. Globs resolve once to existing regular files inside the isolated worktree; creation authority requires an exact new-leaf path. A write outside the resolved list is HARD-BLOCKED even for a registered agent.

testsRequired.description: Commands that must run and pass (or be explicitly INCOMPLETE) before the packet's ledger entry can be PASS. Entries must be non-blank: `bash -lc ""` exits 0 and would be recorded as a passing check that verified nothing.

hostContainmentRequired.description: Optional exact top-level macOS containment command. When declared it is separate from testsRequired and its zero-skip exact-subject receipt is mandatory.

stopConditions.description: Conditions under which the agent must STOP and hand off rather than continue (mirrors DIRECT-AGENT-BYPASS-CONTROL stop conditions).

authorization.description: The override surface. Empty/false everywhere = packet authorizes only ordinary allowed ops. Each true/non-empty field is logged to the ledger.

authorizedBy.description: Human/owner who authorized any exception. 'none' if no exception requested. Must be non-blank: a whitespace-only name is not an authorization.

allowsProtectedPaths.description: Exact protected paths this packet may touch. Each must also be a protected-paths.json entry; the gate logs the pairing.

allowsRelease.description: Permits a customer-facing release; release still requires the KRITE content-contract gate to pass — this flag does not bypass KRITE.

examples.objective: Fix the reorder-supplier duplicate-draft bug in luke-app order-ops without touching catalog or pricing canon.
constraints: Reuse existing order-ops module; do not rebuild it
No edits to any protected-paths.json entry
Anti-theater: claim done only with files+commands+tests in the same response
stopConditions: the fix would require editing packages/protocol-core/data/catalog.json
Claude Code fails twice on the same delegated code issue
Marc issues STOP / delegate / canon language
